Stable Story#000.src: Howdy! Lookin' to hitch a ride off to {p}? Well, lucky you! The wagon's been fixed up all nice and new!

Stable Story#001.src: Just hop on aboard, and I'll get you to {p} in a jiffy!

Stable Story#002.src: Ain't far to {p} from here! We'll be there in a jiffy, just you wait.

Stable Story#003.src: Usually, I'd be charging a high price for these horses- Not to be rude, but one you couldn't afford.

Stable Story#004.src: So, let's cut a deal- They stole my stable key. If you can go to my barn in {p}...

Stable Story#005.src: And return that key to me, I'll so charitably bestow upon you one of my horses. This deal is sweeter than you realize, too...

Stable Story#006.src: Hm. Cows, huh? Ah- who knows!? Life is full of mysteries, huh?

Stable Story#007.src: Either way. As the great bovine above is my witness if I see the smallest bruise on Betty I will-

Stable Story#008.src: Ah! I can't just hand you a horse without telling you how to care for that beautiful creature, can I?

Stable Story#009.src: Those rich {p} folk have no respect for horses, let me tell you!

Stable Story#010.src: Now! Right Click the Feeder and place your [Horse Saddle] in there.

Stable Story#011.src: Use the [{~} Wheat Grains] I gave you earlier to feed your new friend.

Stable Story#012.src: Just Right Click the Feeder again.

Stable Story#013.src: Horses are sensitive creatures, you see. They don't grow strong over night, they require patience and a good stable diet.

Stable Story#014.src: However, you also need to take them out on walks so they get some well needed exercise, otherwise they will never reach their full potential.

Stable Story#015.src: I almost forgot! If you really want to master the art of a horse trainer you can breed two horses using the Feeder.

Stable Story#016.src: Anyway! I wish you luck on your horse training career!

Stable Story#018.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers! Preferably with no friends or family, but I'm not picky!
Stable Story#018.dst: Ищу крепких искателей приключений! Лучше без друзей и семьи, но я не привередлив!
Stable Story#018.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#019.src: You see, I'm a horse merchant. Make my living selling these beauties to adventurers like you.
Stable Story#019.dst: Видишь ли, я торгую лошадьми. Живу тем, что продаю этих красавиц таким, как ты.
Stable Story#019.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#020.src: I work at this barn, selling the horses I raise in {p} out here to rich {p} folk.
Stable Story#020.dst: Держу эту конюшню: лошадей, что ращу в {p}, продаю здесь богачам из {p}.
Stable Story#020.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#021.src: Until these rabble-rousing troublemakers blew a tunnel through my barn and smuggled MY horses out.
Stable Story#021.dst: Пока эти смутьяны не взорвали туннель под моей конюшней и не увели МОИХ лошадей.
Stable Story#021.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#022.src: Usually, I'd be charging a high price for these horses Not to be rude, but one you couldn't afford.
Stable Story#022.dst: Обычно я прошу за них высокую цену Не в обиду, но тебе она не по карману.
Stable Story#022.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#023.src: So, let's cut a deal They stole my stable key. If you can go to my barn in {p}...
Stable Story#023.dst: Так что давай договоримся Они украли ключ от конюшни. Если сходишь в мою конюшню в {p}…
Stable Story#023.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#024.src: And return the key to me, I'll so charitably bestow upon you one of my horses. This deal is sweeter than you realize, too...
Stable Story#024.dst: И вернёшь мне ключ, я щедро подарю тебе одну из лошадей. Сделка слаще, чем тебе кажется…
Stable Story#024.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#025.src: Betty'll be there to help! Strong as she is, don't you DARE let them touch her!
Stable Story#025.dst: Там тебе поможет Betty! Она сильная, но не СМЕЙ дать её тронуть!
Stable Story#025.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#026.src: I'll be making my way to {p} myself to ensure Betty's safety.
Stable Story#026.dst: Я и сам отправлюсь в {p}, чтобы Betty была цела.
Stable Story#026.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#027.src: Now, best be on your way. {p} is a fair bit down the {p} from here, off to the east.
Stable Story#027.dst: А теперь ступай. {p} довольно далеко вниз по {p} отсюда, к востоку.
Stable Story#027.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#028.src: Bring back [{~} Stable Key] to Enkser from the tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Stable Story#028.dst: Принеси [{~} Stable Key] Enkser из туннеля на [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Stable Story#029.src: Hey, have you found my [{~} Stable Key] yet? It should be somewhere in {p} to the east.
Stable Story#029.dst: Эй, [{~} Stable Key] уже у тебя? Он должен быть где-то в {p} к востоку.
Stable Story#029.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#030.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers, preferably with no friends or
Stable Story#030.dst: Ищу крепких искателей приключений, лучше без друзей и
Stable Story#030.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#031.src: Hey, it's you! Got my barn key yet?
Stable Story#031.dst: Эй, это ты! Ключ от конюшни есть?
Stable Story#031.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#032.src: Ah, god bless. And I presume Betty did all the work while you just lounged around.
Stable Story#032.dst: Ах, слава богу. Небось, всю работу сделала Betty, а тебе оставалось лишь бездельничать.
Stable Story#032.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#033.src: Hm. Cows, huh? Ah who knows!? Life is full of mysterious, huh?
Stable Story#033.dst: Хм. Коровы, говоришь? Ах, кто знает!? Жизнь полна загадок, а?
Stable Story#033.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#034.src: Either way. As the great bovine above is my witness if I see the smallest bruise I will
Stable Story#034.dst: В общем. Великая небесная корова мне свидетель: если увижу хоть синячок, я
Stable Story#034.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#035.src: Nevermind all that. A horse I promised, and a horse you shall have. Much thanks to you.
Stable Story#035.dst: Ладно, забудем. Лошадь обещал - лошадь получишь. Большое тебе спасибо.
Stable Story#035.speaker: Enkser
